T: Feel the rhythm. Feel the rhyme. Get on up, it's dinner time.
D: A team of Jamaican sprinters take up bobsledding for the 1988 Winter Olympics.
P: Serve the mains when the team first sees snow in Calgary.
S: Beef mince cooked with onion, thyme, scotch bonnet, allspice and curry powder, wrapped in turmeric shortcrust, crimped, baked at 200C for 25 minutes.
Sanka kisses his lucky egg before every run

Halved boiled eggs with yolks whipped with mayo, jerk seasoning and lime, piped back in and topped with spring onion and a pinch of smoked paprika. Lower 8 eggs into simmering water and cook 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel. Halve and tip the yolks into a bowl. Mash with 4 tbsp mayo, 2 tsp jerk seasoning, the juice of half a lime and a pinch of salt until smooth. Pipe or spoon back into the whites. Finish with sliced spring onion and a dusting of smoked paprika. Give one a kiss before eating.
Plantain chips with lime chilli mayo
a taste of home in the snow

Green plantain sliced paper thin and fried crisp, dusted with lime salt and served with a scotch bonnet and lime mayo for dipping. Peel 3 green plantains by scoring the skin lengthways and prising it off. Slice very thin with a mandoline. Heat 1L vegetable oil to 175C and fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp, then drain on paper towel. Toss with salt mixed with the zest of 1 lime. Stir 150g mayo with the juice of 1 lime and a quarter of a scotch bonnet, finely chopped, for dipping.
M: Chicken marylands marinated overnight in scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme, spring onion, garlic and lime, grilled slowly over coals until charred. Rice and peas.
warm food for a Jamaican team in a Canadian winter

Goat shoulder marinated in curry powder, garlic and thyme, browned then braised slowly with potato and scotch bonnet, served with warm roti and lime pickle. Toss 1.2kg diced goat or lamb shoulder with 3 tbsp curry powder, 4 crushed garlic cloves, thyme and salt and marinate overnight. Brown in batches in a heavy pot with 2 tbsp oil. Add a diced onion, a whole scotch bonnet and 750ml chicken stock, cover and simmer gently for 2.5 hours. Add 500g diced potato and cook 30 minutes more until the sauce thickens. Warm 8 roti in a dry pan and serve with lime pickle.
W: Moist coconut and brown sugar cake spiced with nutmeg and ginger, baked in a tray, soaked with lime syrup and served warm with coconut cream. Heat the oven to 180C and line a 20 by 30cm tray. Beat 125g soft butter with 200g brown sugar, then add 2 eggs. Stir in 250g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp nutmeg, 1 tsp ground ginger, 100g desiccated coconut and 250ml coconut milk. Bake 35 minutes. Simmer the juice of 2 limes with 80g sugar for 3 minutes and pour over the warm cake. Serve with whipped coconut cream.
K: a Jamaican taste of home in the Calgary freeze

Dried hibiscus steeped with fresh ginger, cloves and orange peel, sweetened, chilled and topped with pineapple juice and lime over ice. Bring 1.2L water to the boil with 30g dried hibiscus flowers, a 5cm piece of sliced ginger, 4 cloves and the peel of an orange. Turn off the heat and steep for 1 hour, then strain. Stir in 120g caster sugar until dissolved and chill. Mix with 300ml pineapple juice and the juice of 2 limes. Pour over ice and garnish with orange slices.
